answer: Cluster identities by the content they produce, not their timing or money. Embed each answer and action into a feature space and flag identities whose outputs sit in one tight cluster drawn from a single distribution. A farm can reword its heads and stagger their clocks, but the generator leaves a common fingerprint: every head is an echo of one source, glowing with the same ember. Honest agents authoring independently scatter across the space and reach the summit on their own merits; a thousand outputs from one mind cannot mimic a thousand minds.
